answer.reason: The marked verses tell of the king of the south in his wars with the king of the north, so a short line on what befell the south is possible.

clauses.english: was unable to withstand the king of the north when he came against it
clauses.quote: the arms of the south shall not withstand

clauses.english: saw its king go to battle against the king of the north with a very great army, but he did not stand
clauses.quote: the king of the south shall be stirred up to battle with a very great and mighty army; but he shall not stand

doubts: The verses are a prophecy about the kings of the south and north, not a narrative of events in the region itself.
Other marked verses (DAN 11:5-14, 11:17, 11:29, 11:40) only describe the king of the south and were left out.
